item.name: DigiLocker APIs

query.description: (Optional) Filter records by specific file path

request.description:
Fetches the list of all uploaded health records from DigiLocker for the authenticated user.

🔗 Endpoint: GET /api/digi-locker/records/list
📤 Response: DigiLockerHealthRecordResponse

📝 Fields in response:
- isUserExist: boolean
- isAccountExist: boolean
- authURL: string
- selfUploaded: List<String>
- unSupportedHip: List<String>
- uploadedRecordListResponse: DigiLockerUploadedRecordListResponse

header.description: (Optional) Create a new user with same ABHA number if not present. Default: false

request.description:
Fetches DigiLocker account details for the currently authenticated user.

🔗 Endpoint: GET /api/digi-locker/account
📤 Response: DigiLockerHealthRecordResponse

📌 Header: CREATE-USER = true | false (default: false)

query.description: (Required) Authorization code received from DigiLocker OAuth 2.0 redirect
(Required) State parameter from DigiLocker OAuth flow

request.description:
OAuth 2.0 callback endpoint. DigiLocker redirects to this endpoint with 'code' and 'state' after user authorizes the app.

🔗 Endpoint: GET /api/digi-locker/getCode
📤 Response: DigiLockerStatusResponse

⚠️ No auth headers required — this is the OAuth redirect callback.

📝 Response Fields:
- message: string
- status: string
- statusCode: string
- lockerStatus: string

header.description: (Required) Whether to persist the locker status to DB. Values: true | false

request.description:
Get the current account status of DigiLocker (e.g., ACTIVE, FAILED, PROCESSED).

🔗 Endpoint: GET /api/digi-locker/status
📤 Response: DigiLockerStatusResponse

📌 SAVE-LOCKER-STATUS header: if true, persists the status to database.

Upload a health record document to DigiLocker.

🔗 Endpoint: POST /api/digi-locker/upload
📥 Request Body: DigiLockerUploadRequest
📤 Response: DigiLockerUploadResponse

📝 Request Body Fields:
- attachment (String, Required): Base64 encoded file content
- fileName (String, Required): File name with extension

✅ Supported formats: jpg, jpeg, png, pdf

📝 Response Fields:
- response: string
- status: string
- statusCode: string
- message: string

query.description: (Required) Path of the file in DigiLocker
(Required) Name of the file to read

request.description:
Read / download an already uploaded health record from DigiLocker.

🔗 Endpoint: GET /api/digi-locker/records/read
📤 Response: DigiLockerUploadedRecordReadResponse

📝 Response Fields:
- response: DigiLockerUploadedRecordReadDataResponse
- status: string
- statusCode: int
- message: string

Fetch the list of incoming health records from DigiLocker for a given patient/HIP combination.

🔗 Endpoint: POST /api/digi-locker/incoming/records/list
📥 Request Body: IncomingRecordRequest
📤 Response: Object (dynamic)

📝 Request Body Fields:
- abhaAddress (String): ABHA address of user (e.g., user@abdm)
- hip_id (String): HIP (Health Information Provider) ID
- hi_type (String): Health Information type (e.g., DiagnosticReport, Prescription)
- digilockerid (String): DigiLocker user ID
- ts (String): Timestamp in ISO format
- patientId (String): Patient reference ID
- hmac (String): HMAC signature for request validation
- folder_name (String): DigiLocker folder path

Fetch the complete FHIR bundle of incoming health records from DigiLocker.

🔗 Endpoint: POST /api/digi-locker/incoming/records
📥 Request Body: IncomingRecordRequest (same as Fetch Incoming Records List)
📤 Response: Object (FHIR Bundle)

📝 Request Body Fields:
- abhaAddress (String): ABHA address of user (e.g., user@abdm)
- hip_id (String): HIP (Health Information Provider) ID
- hi_type (String): Health Information type (e.g., DiagnosticReport, Prescription)
- digilockerid (String): DigiLocker user ID
- ts (String): Timestamp in ISO format
- patientId (String): Patient reference ID
- hmac (String): HMAC signature for request validation
- folder_name (String): DigiLocker folder path

Trigger a pull/refresh of health records from DigiLocker for a specific patient-care context combination.

🔗 Endpoint: POST /api/digi-locker/pull/records
📥 Request Body: RefreshRecordRequest
📤 Response: Object

📝 Request Body Fields:
- abhaAddress (String): ABHA address of user
- hipId (String): HIP (Health Information Provider) ID
- patientReferenceNumber (String): Patient reference number at HIP
- careContextReferenceNumber (String): Care context reference at HIP
- hiTypes (List<String>): List of health info types to pull
- xAuthToken (String): DigiLocker auth token
- digilockerid (String): DigiLocker user ID
- ts (String): Timestamp in ISO format
- hmac (String): HMAC signature for request validation

query.description: (Required) HIP ID to fetch refreshed records from

request.description:
Fetch refreshed health records from a specific HIP (Health Information Provider).

🔗 Endpoint: GET /api/digi-locker/hip/pull/records
📤 Response: Object

📝 Query Params:
- hipId (String, Required): The HIP ID to pull records from

request.description:
**Controller Method:** `search()` — BloodBankController.java

**Mapped to:** `@PostMapping(value = SEARCH_ENDPOINT)` → `/api/blood-bank/search`

**Required @RequestHeaders:**
- `REQUEST_ID` — Unique UUID (auto-generated by pre-request script)
- `TIMESTAMP` — UTC timestamp (auto-generated; server overrides it with getCurrentUTCTimestamp())
- `X-Token` — Authentication token

**@RequestBody:** Raw JSON string → passed to `bloodBankSearchService.processSearch()`

Gateway ko search request bhejta hai. Response: ACK. Actual results on_search callback mein aate hain.

request.description:
**Controller Method:** `onSearch()` — BloodBankController.java

**Mapped to:** `@PostMapping(value = ON_SEARCH_ENDPOINT)` → `/api/blood-bank/on_search`

**@RequestHeader:** `Map<String, String> headers` — no specific header annotation, accepts all headers

**@RequestBody:** Raw JSON string → passed to `bloodBankOnSearchService.processOnSearch()`

BECKN Gateway ka callback endpoint — Gateway yahan blood bank search results bhejta hai. Response: ACK. Data Kafka queue mein publish hota hai.

**NOTE:** Yeh endpoint typically ABDM Gateway se automatically call hota hai. Testing ke liye manually simulate karo.
